title: YazSes campaign task
description: Generated from FIELD_SPEC in scripts/campaign.py — edit that, not this file. A test fails if this copy is stale.

family.description: One of: compatibility, app-profile, localization, contract-vector, feature-wiring, measurement, docs, packaging, qa-fixture, security-privacy.

title.description: What the contributor will do, in one line.

value.description: Why the project wants it. A task with no stated value is not open.

risk.description: Review lane, one of: L0, L1, L2, L3.

minutes.description: Honest estimate for someone who has not seen the repo.

requires.description: Environment the contributor must actually have (os, desktop, app).

cloud_agent_ready.description: True only if a container can produce the whole evidence.

allowed_paths.description: Globs the PR may touch. Preflight rejects anything else.

validation.description: Exact commands that decide whether the work is done.

evidence.description: What the human must observe and report; empty for pure-code tasks.

state.description: Lifecycle, one of: draft, verified, open, claimed, pr-open, merged, expired, needs-work.

source.description: Where this task came from — an issue, a registry, a doc gap.
